title: Boolean work tape verdict machine
statement: For a natural number $k$ and a selected work tape $i$ among the $k$ work tapes, define a Turing machine with Boolean symbols and states $	ext{left}$, $	ext{read}$, and $	ext{done}(b)$ for $b\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. Its initial state is $	ext{left}$. In state $	ext{left}$ it moves the head of work tape $i$ one cell left and enters $	ext{read}$; in state $	ext{read}$, if the scanned cell contains $b$, it erases that cell and enters $	ext{done}(b)$, while a blank cell leads to $	ext{done}(\mathrm{false})$ without changing the tape. In state $	ext{done}(b)$ it remains in that state without moving the input head.
hypotheses_covered: The number $k$ of work tapes is a natural number
The selected tape index $i$ belongs to the $k$ work tapes
